contextWindow.value: 16k tokens for SmolVLM (2.2B); 8k tokens for smaller variants (256M, 500M)

source.quote: Accordingly, we adopt a 16k-token context for SmolVLM and an 8k-token limit for smaller variants.

modalities.value: image and video with text (vision-language multimodal)

source.quote: models extend beyond static images, demonstrating robust video comprehension capabilities.

totalParams.value: family ranging from 256M to 2.2B (SmolVLM-256M, SmolVLM-500M, SmolVLM-2.2B)

source.quote: We introduced SmolVLM, a family of memory-efficient Vision-Language Models ranging from 256M to 2.2B

architecture.value: SigLIP vision encoder (93M SigLIP-B/16 for 256M/500M; 400M SigLIP-SO400M for 2.2B) with pixel-shuffle and MLP projection into a SmolLM2 backbone (135M / 360M / 1.7B); self-attention VLM with image splitting

source.quote: where encoded images are pooled and projected into a SmolLM2 backbone.

trainingData.value: two stages: vision (mixture from Laurençon et al. 2024 plus MathWriting; documents, captioning, VQA, charts, tables, reasoning, some text Q&A) then video fine-tuning (LLaVA-video-178k, Video-STAR, Vript, ShareGPT4Video, Vista-400k, MovieChat, FineVideo, M4-Instruct, Mammoth; text from Xu et al. 2024)

source.quote: Model training proceeds in two stages: (1) a vision stage, and (2) a video stage.

notes: Capability/architecture technical report (arXiv 2504.05299). No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias/fairness, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability section or measured results; evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. BioVQA is named only as a downstream biomedical VQA application, not a bio risk eval. Paper names SmolVLM-256M / 500M / 2.2B; mapped 2.2B to HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-Instruct (~2.25B params). Left out seed-linked SmolVLM2-* because the body never names SmolVLM2 as a model (only blog/demo URL paths). ArXiv date is not treated as model releaseDate. Skipped capability benches: OCRBench, AI2D, ChartQA, TextVQA, DocVQA, ScienceQA, MMMU, MathVista, MMStar, Video-MME, MLVU, MVBench, WorldSense, TempCompass, OpenCompass image/video ablations, CIDEr/VQA configuration sweeps, and throughput/RAM figures.
